summary: Executes REALIGNMENT §2.4 (one address per shape: a forwarding node's gap store is the holder's, and a stale local copy must retire) and law 8 (readers must not act on a stale copy); not a new plan. On a forwarding node (its gap store forwards to a remote holder), development-vessel's boot-time gap-store merge migration (src/index.ts ~:410-414 calls runGapStoreMergeMigration in src/resolvers/gap-store-merge-migration.ts; the file path comes from substrate-gap.ts gapStoreFilePath() / GAPS_PATH ~:433) still reads the local gaps/gaps.json, which is untracked, gitignored and a stale copy from 2026-09-30. The migration id embeds the file's sha prefix and the endpoint hash (~:77-78); a completed merge writes gaps/gap-store-merge.done.json (~:11, :37), and any chunk that is not verified writes no marker, so the next start runs it again (~:20, :95). The last attempt (2026-10-23T19:57:45Z, at a development-vessel install) had chunk 1/2 refused by the holder with merge_principal_required, and wrote no done marker. So the migration retries on every boot and can never succeed under that refusal, and the stale local copy never retires. Readers of the local copy (for example a lease check) are misled by it (related: solicitation-outcome-scan-reads-the-local-gaps-file-so-a-spoke-scans-five-day-old-state). Fix: a merge_principal_required refusal is a shaped decline (the merge needs a principal this node does not hold): record it with its reason, stop retrying until the principal or the holder changes, and retire or quarantine the local copy so no reader takes it as state; or run the merge under the principal the holder requires. CLASS QUESTION: what detects a boot migration that has no done marker and retries across N boots? Today nothing does: the retry is a log line per start. LANE: operator_build (normal priority, under the USER authorization ~22:28Z 2026-10-23); the edit site itself is lane-open in the scope.
falsifier_spec: On a forwarding node, after one boot, either the migration done marker exists and the local file has been retired, or the migration declines with a shaped reason and does not retry on the next boot.
must_fail: A test where a merge_principal_required refusal at the fix parent leaves no done marker and a retry occurs on the next start (red at the parent; after the fix, the refusal is recorded as a shaped decline and no retry occurs).
control: A migration whose chunks are all verified writes the done marker and is skipped on the next start (already_merged), as today.
